title: Errors per 1000 views
sqlTemplate: select count(*) filter (where type = 'error') as errors, count(*) filter (where type = 'view') as views, case when count(*) filter (where type = 'view') = 0 then null else count(*) filter (where type = 'error') * 1000.0 / count(*) filter (where type = 'view') end as errors_per_1000_views from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}}
emptyDataSemantics: denominator (views) = 0 -> errors_per_1000_views is SQL NULL -> NO_DATA, never 0, even if errors > 0.
